sources.entry: Neverkin - Collaborative writing, worldbuilding and D&D-session-planning app. Tools for organizing your notes and stories. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Neverkin is an open-source, non-commercial collaborative writing and worldbuilding app aimed at storytellers, DMs, writers and novelists, including D&D session planning.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web app for collaborative writing and worldbuilding, with an interactive mindmap, rich text editing, wiki and character pages, and relations between entries made through @mentions. It supports real-time collaboration, multi-track timelines, and custom calendars. It is pitched at planning D&D sessions, writing fanfiction with friends, and keeping notes. The stack is a React/TypeScript frontend (Styx), Koa.js backend services (Rhea and Calliope) using Prisma with PostgreSQL and Redis, and an Nginx proxy (Gatekeeper), deployed on Docker Swarm. A desktop application is also offered as a download. The README says a development environment runs with npm and Docker, and that a self-hosting guide exists for building your own cluster.
how_to_run: Self-hosting: follow the self-hosting documentation (referenced in README; requires Docker Swarm for the described architecture)
notable: Interactive mindmap combined with wiki and character pages
caveats: The described architecture is built for Docker Swarm microservices, which adds setup complexity for self-hosting
The README says the developer's backups run every 6 hours and recommends users keep their own backups
Default admin credentials are listed in the README and should be changed for any real deployment
